parameters: Taro kneels beside the fallen warrior, who looks like they are badly wounded and about to die.
"That spawning machine...  Its the cause of all our problems...  Need to shut off the power to it...  From the power reactor room...
On the top floor...  The power control computers...  They need a login and password to shut off the power...  Would shut down the spawner...
The password may be on a computer in that room over there...  Behind locked door...  Needs a black key card...  But...
"Another...  Way...  A ninja or even thief...  Just hack the power room computer...  Quickly solve everything...  And...  And...
We would not have died for...  for nothing...  Taro...  I...  I...  *COUGH*  I...  *DEATH COUGH*  Taro...  nnnnnggggghhhhh..."
He's dead, and isn't going to say anything more.
The bad guy spawning machine seems to be drawing power from the building's power supply somehow.  You can't shut it off from here.
"Ha!  Deactivated!  We have done our job here."
"You have done our people a great service.  Here is your reward money, as promised."
You get a Strange Crystal Gemstone!
"I found it in this place and it doesn't belong here.  You might as well have it.  My town has no need for it.  Come!  Let's go!"
You don't have the right key card to open this door.
"Open this chest!  We can use this!  You have my permission."
This door doesn't have any button or way to open it from here.  It has a warning light, not currently lit, for warning when something is
about to come out of the door.
This door doesn't have any button or way to open it from here.  It looks like it has a reader for a remote control to open it, of the type found
in an indoor forklift or small indoor vehicle.
This door doesn't have any button or way to open it from here.  It looks like it has a reader for an electronic key card,

This door doesn't have any button or way to open it from here.  It looks like it has a reader for an electronic key card,

Double arrows towards the elevator indicate passage of forklifts and heavy cargo to go on elevators on this level.
Double arrows away from the elevator signify forklifts and heavy cargo from another floor come out of such elevators.
Arrows in both directions mean small cargo carried by persons, and people themselves, go in and out of such elevators."
